numerical_failure.observed_behavior: Angle("1d2m59.49999s").to_string(precision=0) returns '1d03m00s' (seconds carry into minutes too early, threshold a full unit below 60); Angle("285d29m41.76s").to_string(fields=1) returns '286d' (rounded twice, seconds into minutes then minutes into degrees).
trigger_conditions: seconds value just below the half-unit carry point in the last displayed digit (e.g. 59.49999 at precision 0)
fields=1 with minutes/seconds that round the degrees only when rounded once (e.g. 29m41.76s)
precision given as 0 or 1 for the seconds carry case
fields=1 rounding applied to minutes and seconds together
oracle_clues: Tests in astropy/coordinates/tests/test_formatting.py parametrized over angle, precision, expected strings
Commit message states NumPy round disagrees with formatting on ties such as 59.995 at precision 2, so builtin round on a float is used
PR reports 295 changed for fields=1 and 365 and 19 for fields=3 at precision 0 and 1 over 40,000 angles per case

numerical_characteristics.precision: precision=0 and precision=1 for fields=3 (per PR counts); the builtin round on a float is required because NumPy's round disagrees with formatting on ties such as 59.995 at precision 2
numerical_characteristics.magnitude: seconds values near the half-unit carry threshold (e.g. 59.49999s, 59.5s, 59.96s, 41.76s for fields=1 degree carry at 30 minutes)
numerical_characteristics.tolerance: no numerical tolerance stated; the carry separates at half a unit in the last displayed digit (e.g. 59.49999s no carry, 59.5s carries at precision 0)
category_specific_evidence: Angle("1d2m59.49999s").to_string(precision=0) gives 1d03m00s but should give 1d02m59s, because the old carry threshold sat a full unit below 60 instead of half a unit
Angle("285d29m41.76s").to_string(fields=1) gives 286d but should give 285d, because seconds and minutes were rounded in two separate steps
Builtin round is needed rather than NumPy round because NumPy disagrees with formatting on ties such as 59.995 at precision 2
PR reports that over 40,000 angles per case the change moves 295 results for fields=1 and 365 and 19 results for fields=3 at precision 0 and 1
Test cases cover negative angles such as -1d2m59.49999s and boundary cases such as 1d59m59.5s rounding to 2d00m00s
reproduction_risks: Using NumPy round instead of builtin round on a float changes results on ties
Rounding seconds into minutes before comparing to 60 causes double rounding
The PR counts of changed angles depend on the 40,000-angle sample and may not reproduce exactly
